reviews.comment:
Es buena estación de servicio u casi la mejor de la ruta le pongo tres estrellas porque el playero después de hacer toda la cola no nos quiso cargar combustible porque dice que no cruza la manguera y tuvimos que hacer toda la cola nuevamente eso no me.paso en ninguna YPF del resto de toda la provincia

(Translated by Google)
It's a good gas station, almost the best on the route. I'm giving it three stars because the attendant, after we waited in line the whole time, refused to fill our tank, saying the hose wouldn't flow. We had to wait in line again. That never happened to me at any other YPF station in the entire province.
